speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I am Dr. Agent; since you are a newborn presenting with a generalized rash, we need to determine when the rash started and if it is itchy or painful. Can you also tell me if you have been breastfeeding or if there is any family history of similar skin conditions?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Dermatitis. The history of maternal gonorrhea, the term birth status, and the acute onset of a generalized rash in a 4-day-old newborn is highly suggestive of this infection, which can progress rapidly to conjunctivitis or septic arthritis. I will order a Gram stain and culture of a skin lesion to confirm the diagnosis.
